label: Qualified report of one’s own affection: Report e w evaluates a report of the token’s own affection
term: qualified report of one’s own affection
definition: Report e w evaluates a report of the token’s own affection; AffectionReportCorrect requires this report true where a target token occurs, explicitly restricting it to the affection as it is affected. This is a stipulated ideal-report restriction, not a thesis of infallibility for ordinary introspection; comparison to the historical honey argument is deferred. It differs from judging whether honey is actually bitter. The report/content equivalence is tested separately. Its actual cognitive applicability remains OPEN.
